Based on your history of outdoor exposure and symptoms like muscle aches, dark urine, and potential joint pain, I am concerned about an infectious cause like Hantavirus or Leptospirosis rather than just an autoimmune issue. Did you have any direct contact with rodent droppings or urine while camping, and have you noticed any redness or swelling in your ankles or wrists?

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (ME/CFS). With normal blood work, urinalysis, and liver function, and no evidence of specific infectious agents like Hantavirus or Leptospirosis despite your camping history, your symptoms of profound fatigue disproportionate to exertion and worsening later in the day are most consistent with ME/CFS.
